title: A Prayer for Our Country During a Time of Division – 5786, by David Abernethy
author: David Abernethy

coauthors.name: David Abernethy
coauthors.bio: David Abernethy is a retired lawyer living near Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.  He is a member of the Beth Am Israel community in Penn Valley, Pennsylvania.

excerpt: "A Prayer for Our Country During a Time of Division – 5786" was offered by David Abernethy on 1 March 2026.
content:
A prayer for the United States of America, during a time when we are deeply divided – and a plea for unity, respect and civility in our country.
Contribute a translation Source (English)
Our God and God of our ancestors,
with mercy and understanding
accept our prayer
for our country
and for ourselves.
Help us find the strength
to put away despair
at the hatred and division
in our land,
and to reach out to one another
to seek peace and reconciliation
throughout our country
and all Creation.
Instill in us the courage
to speak out against
the violence and oppression
in our nation,
and to uproot
the violence and oppression
in our own hearts.
Grant us the wisdom
to close our ears
to words of anger and contempt,
and to open our mouths
to speak words of shalom,
to friends and strangers,
supporters and adversaries alike.
And help us do these things
with faith that others will too,
and that together we may find peace
despite our differences,
freedom unburdened by violence or fear,
and renewed blessing from the One
who helped our forebears create
the United States of America
as a nation dedicated to liberty,
opportunity
and tolerance
for all.
And let us say Amen.

“A Prayer for Our Country During a Time of Division – 5786” was offered by David Abernethy on 1 March 2026.
